author: AlvaroMorata
body:
So, I was thinking to promote clans on avicus. Over night I was thinking how cool if we had a league... It could be really cool.. Instead of scrims we can have a league table.. I know there is avicus tourny but after that there isn't going to be anything... So maybe people can volunteer to be refs and hopefully the avicus network becomes the next "MLG" of minecraft :P I am talking about nebula and nexus!

Thank you for reading comment down below if you think it's a good idea
